description: Claim is a filing sentence verbatim; evidence is its own three-sentence context window
One number scaled by a factor of +/-15-60% or two adjacent digits swapped
Company name replaced with a different ticker's registered company name
Directional word flipped (increased/decreased, above/below, gain/loss, higher/lower) or 'not' inserted/removed
Unperturbed sentence paired with a context window from a different filing (token overlap < 0.2)
